_comment: Retail decisions the D4 schedule cannot flip, each with the reason the retail program cannot reach the other outcome inside the engine's input domain. tools/d3_coverage.py (gate D4c) fails on any one-sided decision not listed here.

decisions.reason: tests x >= -x on x = (randFloat.z * 16 + |position.z|) / 16; randFloat is the engine's per-instance phase in [0, 1), so x is never negative (a negative randFloat also indexes the 20-row wave table out of range)
the Scene.fx__vs_scene_aux wave phase again (scene_foliage_transparent_noisy_deform_vertextest): x = (randFloat.z * 16 + |position.z|) / 16 with randFloat in [0, 1), never negative
fxc's sign handling of fmod(x, 1) on the colour-grading LUT coordinate x = scene texel * 63/8 (or * 7.875); the scene colour is sampled from an unsigned-normalized target, so x is never negative
